title: Does Pinnacle Blooms Network allow parents to participate in their child's Speech Therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Parental Involvement in Speech Therapy Sessions | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Find out how Pinnacle Blooms Network encourages parents to actively participate in their child's speech therapy sessions, reinforcing progress and fostering a supportive home environment.
html: Yes, we do, and we wholeheartedly encourage it! We value the role of parents in creating a nurturing environment for children with autism. By taking part in the therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network, parents can understand the techniques and activities used, which can then be practiced at home. We believe this ongoing support outside of our therapy rooms significantly contributes towards the child’s progress.
